examples.arabic: نحنا شفنا غياب الشمس الحلو من الشباك.
examples.english: We saw the beautiful sunset from the window.
examples.transliteration: Nihna shufna ghiyab al shams al hulu min al shibbak.

examples.arabic: طلعت من الشباك وشفت الجو فيه ضباب كتير
examples.english: I looked out the window and saw the weather was very foggy
examples.transliteration: Tlaat min al shibbak w shifet al jaw fi dabab ktir

examples.arabic: فجاة شفت برق من الشباك وعرفت انو الطقس صار عاصف
examples.english: Suddenly I saw lightning from the window and I knew that the weather became windy.
examples.transliteration: Fajaah shefet barq men el shubbak w arafet inno el taqes sar aasef

examples.arabic: ضحكنا على صوت الريح العاصف يلي هز الشباك وحكينا عن خططنا ليوم غائم دافي بالبيت
examples.english: We laughed at the sound of the windy air shaking the window and talked about our plans for a warm cloudy day at home.
examples.transliteration: Dehekna 'ala sawt ir-reeh il-'aasef yalli hazz ish-shubbak w hakeena 'an khutatna la-yom gha'em dafi bil-beet.
examples.storyTitle: A Call on a Stormy Day

examples.arabic: جدتي وجدي قاعدين جنب الشباك عم يشربوا شاي دافي ومبسوطين بالجو العاصف
examples.english: My grandma and grandpa were sitting by the window drinking warm tea and enjoying the stormy weather.
examples.transliteration: Jaddeti w jaddi qa'din janb esh-shubbak 'am yishrabu shay dafi w mabsootin bil jaw el 'asef.

examples.arabic: فجأة سمعت صوت ضربة قوية على الشباك طلعت قطة عم تحاول تهرب من المطر
examples.english: Suddenly I heard a loud bang on the window; it was a cat trying to escape the rain
examples.transliteration: Fajʾa samiʿt ṣōt ḍarbeh qawiyye ʿalash-shubbāk ṭalaʿat qiṭṭa ʿam tiḥāwil tihrab min il-maṭar
